text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Due to her outstanding excellence, Kyaru has decided to graduate with an accelerated program.
text_block_list.orig_text: あまりの優秀さに、超飛び級での卒業が決まったキャル。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Kyaru, who is just one day away from graduation, is packing her belongings in her dorm room.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっという間に卒業を明日に控えたキャルは、
寮の部屋で荷造りをしていた。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Phew, I guess I'll have to say goodbye to this school tomorrow. ...Man, it's way too sudden for me to graduate.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふー、
明日でこの学園ともお別れか。
……
ったく、
急すぎんのよ卒業なんて。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I still want to stay...here with everyone. There are still things left to do in my youth...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだいたいのに……
ここでみんなと。
まだあるのに……
セイシュンでやり残してること……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, actually I've always longed to try it once... 
 After school in the evening, in my uniform...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
実は一回やってみたいって憧れてたのよね……
夕暮れの放課後、
制服で……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: {0}!? Why are you here!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って{0}っっ！！？
なんでいんのよ！！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Because you've finished your own cleanup, you're offering to help me? Ah... originally, you were meant to accompany me, so you'll graduate together with me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分の片付けが済んだから
あたしの手伝いに？
ああ……
元々あたしの付き添いってことだったから、
あたしと一緒にあんたも卒業するのよね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: And what is it that you're giving me? ... Is this a message from Suzuna?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それと渡すものが？
……
これ、
スズナからの伝言？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Dear HaiKai Kyaru-chi, Hello there! Who is wandering around? Don't you dare nitpick my letter!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『はいかい・キャルっち』
拝啓よ拝啓！　
だれが徘徊してるのよ！
手紙でもツッコませんな！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Too many typos and misspellings, hiragana and round-shaped characters, and excessive use of colors make it unreadable...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誤字脱字と、
ひらがなと丸っこい文字と、
色使いまくりで
読みにくすぎるわ……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I see... They're preparing our graduation ceremony, even if it's modest tomorrow. So, they want me to think about the speech for the graduating students' representative.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど……
明日
ささやかだけど、
あたしたちの卒業式を準備してくれてるんですって。
それで
卒業生代表の挨拶を
あたしに考えといてねって。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I know, right? It's kind of awkward to be asked that out of the blue. Besides, we're the only graduates, so who else would be the representative?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく……
そんなこといきなり言われても困るわよ。
そもそも卒業生ってあたしたちしかいないじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, well, pretty much. What about you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん、
まあまあね。
あんたは？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: !! Ah, I'm also having fun with you...It's, it's nothing! Idiot!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
！！　
あ、
あたしもあんたと一緒で
楽し……
な、
なんでもないわよ！　
バカ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: !! Hey, I'm right in front of you, so show a little consideration...? What do you mean... I-I don't know! You idiot!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
！！　
あんたねー
目の前にあたしがいるんだから
ちょっとは気遣いなさいよ……？
え、
なにをって……
し、
知らないわよ！　
バカ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... lately, my emotions have been all over the place... I wonder if it's because of puberty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
なんか最近感情駄々漏れなのよね……
これも、
セイシュンってやつのせいかしら。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! What did you say? Say it again and I'll kill you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
はぁ～～！？
もっぺん言ってみなさい殺すわよ～～！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And then, the day of Kyaru's graduation ceremony.
text_block_list.orig_text: そして、キャルの卒業式、当日。

text_block_list.name: Guests
text_block_list.text: Well, because... uh, that's how it is. Above all, let me offer my congratulations.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーー
であるからして……
あーー
そういうことであります。
うーー
以上、
お祝いの言葉とさせていただきます。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: ... Zzz.

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Wake up, Suzuna-san! The host!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……起きなさいスズナさん！　
司会者！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Fwah, is it over? As expected of a bigwig from the Magic Academy, you're a master of the dangerous Sleep Magic~ Yes, thank you for your kind words~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
ふわぁ、
終わった？
さすが魔法学園のお偉いさま、
おにヤバ睡眠魔法の使い手だね～
はい、
すてきなお言葉
ありがと～ございました♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Next, we will proceed with a cleaning call by the students ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
では続きまして、
在校生による
お掃除の呼びかけを行います♪

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Suzuna-san, please clean up and send off! To the departing Kyaru-san, words of farewell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スズナさーん、
お掃除ジャナクテ、
送辞デース！
去り行くキャルさんへ、
贈る言葉デース！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Hehe, please listen, Kyaru-chan! This is a present from us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
聞いてくださいキャルちゃん！
私たちからの
プレゼントです！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Then let's get started! Live on campus♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあはじめるよ～！
在校生
きり～つ♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...What the hell?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんなのよ？

text_block_list.name: Male Student 1
text_block_list.text: Today, under this blue sky!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日ー、
この青空の下ー！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan, is graduating!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルちゃんはー、
卒業しまーす！

text_block_list.name: All the students in the school
text_block_list.text: you're graduating!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 卒業しまーす！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Something has started!!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんか始まった！！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: In the first class, she was showing off like "Hey, look at me!"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
初めの授業でー、
これ見よがしにドヤッていたー！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Four-eyes
text_block_list.orig_text: クソメガネー！

text_block_list.name: All the students in the school
text_block_list.text: Four-eyes!!
text_block_list.orig_text: クソメガネー！！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: I pretended like I didn't care, I didn't care.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気にならないそぶりでー、
気が気じゃなかったー

text_block_list.name: Male Student 2
text_block_list.text: Love letter!
text_block_list.orig_text: ラブレター！

text_block_list.name: All the students in the school
text_block_list.text: Love letter!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ラブレター！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Choose a more appropriate place, you guys!!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたらもっといい感じのとこチョイスしなさいよ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: She may act tough, but she's actually really nice!
text_block_list.orig_text:
強がってても、
ホントはとっても優しくてー！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Rubbing my sleepy eyes, thank you for studying with me until late at night!
text_block_list.orig_text:
眠い目こすって、
深夜まで勉強に付き合ってくれてー！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Complain all you want, but show lots of smiles during the school trip, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪態つきナガラ、
修学旅行で
いっぱい
笑顔を
見せてクレテー！

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: With overwhelming magical power, please break my arrogant nose!
text_block_list.orig_text:
圧倒的な魔力で、
私の傲慢な鼻を折ってくれてー！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm called a Berserker!
text_block_list.orig_text: バーサーカーって呼ばれても！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times you call me an idiot!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何度バカって言われても！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Even if they scold us for being lovey-dovey!
text_block_list.orig_text: ベタベタすんなって怒られても！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-You too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
あ……
あんたも？

text_block_list.name: All the students in the school
text_block_list.text: I love you!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 大好きです！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Seriously, don't get too cozy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ。
……ホントにいい感じにすんな……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hehe, Kyarucchi, it's okay to cry♪ ...Uuuu~
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
キャルっち、
泣いてもいいんだよ♪
……
ううう～
～～っ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You're not going to cry!!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたが泣くな！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Sorry. I won't cry until after this. ...I'll probably cry a lot later. I'm sure everyone will. After this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
ごめん。
泣くのはこの後だよね。
……
この後
めっちゃ泣いちゃうだろうな。
みんなもきっと大泣きしちゃうね。
この後ので……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: ......Graduates, commencement speech.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……卒業生、
答辞。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: She really raised the bar!!
text_block_list.orig_text: めっちゃハードル上げられた！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I didn't prepare any emotional speech or anything! I'll just say something random...
text_block_list.orig_text:
別に
感動の挨拶なんて用意してないわ！
こんなの適当に……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bwooooooom!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ドゴォォォォォッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: !? What is this rumbling sound...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
！？
な、
なにこの地響き……！！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Look!! What is that giant shadow...! That direction... Principal, could it be...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見ろ！！　
なんだあの巨大な影は……！
あの方向……
学園長、
まさか……！！

text_block_list.name: School director
text_block_list.text: Yes, that place is the underground basement where Arges is sealed...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
あそこはアルゲースが封印された地下室の……！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Arges... huh, I feel like I've heard that recently...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アルゲース……
って、
なんか最近聞いたことあるかも……？

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Yes, I told you... Arges, the one-eyed monster said to have devastated this land 800 years ago...! The legendary Great Sage Ambrose-sama sealed it away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
話したわ……
アルゲースは800年前、
この地を荒らしたといわれる一つ目の魔物……！
大賢者・アンブローズ様に封印されたという伝説の……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that was when that bell had a hole in it... Wait... ...why is that thing returned to life?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
その時にあの鐘に穴が開いたんだっけ……
って……
なんでそんなやつがよみがえってんのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Honestly, it was so long ago that the legend of Ambrose didn’t feel real... In fact, nothing had happened in the past 800 years, and it is certain that the management of the basement was negligent...
text_block_list.orig_text:
正直昔のこと過ぎて、
アンブローズ様の伝説に現実味はなかった……
事実この800年間何も起こらなかったし、
地下室の管理が杜撰だったことは確か……

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Has the seal been broken by someone with malicious intent...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 悪意のある何者かによって封印が解かれた……？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: ...... Um, sorry for bringing this up out of nowhere, but I just remembered. It's about when I decided to transfer to this school...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あの、
今更なんですが思い出しちゃいました。
私がこの学園に編入するって決めた時のこと……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Is this the time to be talking in this situation!?
text_block_list.orig_text: 今この状況で話してる場合ですか！？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: ...At that time, I was asked by Master. Because there is a sealed monster called Arges in this school, she wanted me to protect my brother in case something happened.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……その時私、
マスターから頼まれたんです。
この学園には
アルゲースという魔物が封印されているから、
もしもの時にお兄ちゃんを守ってほしいって。

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: I completely forgot because school life is too much fun...
text_block_list.orig_text:
学園生活が楽しすぎて
すっかり忘れちゃってました……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: What the hell is that supposed to mean?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんですかそれ……！！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Now is not the time to be arguing with each other! Let's grasp the cause of the seal being lifted!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今は言い合ってる場合じゃありまセーン！
封印が解かれた原因を掴むのデース！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Thank you, Ninon-chan! From here, let's go to the basement. Hooray for honor!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん！　
ありがとうニノンちゃん！
ここから名誉万歳です！　
地下室に行ってみましょう！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait, wait, wait...!! Why isn't she coming over here!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとちょっとちょっと……！！
なんかあいつこっち来てない！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey!!! Argesuuchi~!!! Because it's Kyaru's graduation ceremony now!! I might be happy if you could come over there~~~!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～～～い！！　
アルゲースっち～～～！！！
今
キャルっちの卒業式ちうだから～！！
向こう行ってくれるとうれしいかも～～～！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: There's no way the monster can hear your voice!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 魔物に声が届くわけないでしょ！！

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Shut up, you noisy human... It Echos in my waking mind...
text_block_list.orig_text:
黙れ人間
キンキンと……
寝覚めの頭に響く……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It talked a lot!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: めっちゃしゃべった！！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: ...Ah!? Look, Kyarucchi!! It's grabbing someone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ！？　
見てキャルっち！！
あいつ、
人つかんでる！

text_block_list.name: Assassin
text_block_list.text: Damn it!! L-Let go of me!! I-I'm the one who released you from your seal, you know!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいい！！　
お、
おい離せよ！！
俺はお前の封印を解いてやった恩人様だぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Do not be conceited, human. Even without your help, I had already awakened. That unpleasant sound from 800 years ago still lingers in my ears... the moment I heard that detestable bell sound!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぬぼれるな人間。
お前の力など借りずとも
我は目覚めていた。
……今も耳の奥に残る
800年前の不快な音……
あの忌々しい鐘の音を聞いた瞬間になぁ……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'm the reason you came back to life!? Is that what you're saying!?
text_block_list.orig_text: よみがえったのあたしのせいっぽいーー！！？

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Fragile humans should have long since reached the end of their lifespans. Hateful Ambrose... I wanted to tear you apart with my own hands!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……脆い人間はとうに寿命が尽きておるだろうな。
憎きアンブローズ……
貴様はこの手で
八つ裂きにしてやりたかったぞ……！

text_block_list.name: Assassin
text_block_list.text: Anything will do! Just wreak havoc on that academy! That's the mission assigned to me...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんでもいいからよ……！！
お前はあの学園をめちゃくちゃにしてくれればいいんだ……！！
それが
俺に与えられた任務……！！

text_block_list.name: Assassin
text_block_list.text: I... I will complete my mission and receive a hefty reward from the nobleman... With that money, I'll go to the tropical islands... live a life of leisure...!! Gaaaahh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お……
俺は任務をやり遂げ、
貴族様からたんまり報酬を貰うんだ……
その金で南国でも行ってよ……
悠々自適な生活を……！！
ぎゃああっ！！

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Can't you hear me telling you to shut up...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 黙れといっているのが聞こえないのか…！！

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Now that Ambrose is gone, I'll unleash this hatred on the world... First, I shall destroy it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンブローズがいない今、
この憎しみは世界にぶつけよう……
まずは手始めに
破壊してやる。

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Ambrose Academy of Magic. This is the name that makes me nauseous, this place of learning!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンブローズ魔法学園。
吐き気を催す名を冠する、
この学び舎をなぁぁ！！

text_block_list.name: Butler
text_block_list.text: Eeek!! M-Master! What would you like me to do!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひい
っ！！　
だ、
旦那様！
いい、
いかがなさいますか！？

text_block_list.name: Aristocrat
text_block_list.text: It's... not a joke! I didn't sign up for something this big! All I had to do was get in the way of Kyaru's graduation ceremony...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
し……
洒落にならん……！
こんな大ごとになるなんて聞いてないぞ！？
私は
キャルの卒業式が邪魔されるだけで良かったんだ……！

text_block_list.name: Aristocrat
text_block_list.text: I won't stand for being dragged into this just because I came to witness their pitiful faces! I have no idea!! I have absolutely no involvement in this matter!! I'm getting out of here now!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
奴の悲痛な顔を拝みに来ただけなのに
巻き込まれてたまるか！
…
…知らん！！　
私はこの件に一切関与していない！！
今すぐ逃げるぞ！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: I won't let you get away!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 逃がしません！！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: The walls have ears, and the shoji have eyes...! I heard everything you just said, you rotten Regedo...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
壁に耳アリ、
障子に目アリ……！
今の話は
全て聞きましたよ、
この腐レゲドー……！！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Tehehe... You've dared to tarnish that person's moment in the spotlight, haven't you? Prepare yourself, you piece of trash!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス……
よくもあのおかたの晴れの舞台を汚しましたね？
覚悟しなさいこのゴミくずめが！！

text_block_list.name: Nobles & Butlers
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Now, shall I try releasing magic power for the first time in 800 years...
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
800年ぶりに魔力を解放してみるか……

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Nnngh!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぬぅんっ！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Guh...!! This guy... what kind of magical power...!! It's seriously dangerous...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ
……！！
こいつ……
なんて魔力……！！
相当ヤバイわね……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'll buy us some time, so you evacuate everyone!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あたしがなんとか時間を稼ぐから、
あんたはみんなを避難させて！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd say that...! I'm sorry, but this isn't the time for arguing! hurry up and get everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたならそう言うと思ってたわ……！
悪いけど
言い合いしてる場合じゃないの！
早くみんなを……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I won't run away!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 逃げないよ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Suzuna...?!
text_block_list.orig_text: スズナ……！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: It's only been a short time, but this school has been filled with lots of fun thanks to you, Kyarucchi. I won't let it be destroyed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
短い間だったけど、
キャルっちのアオハルがいっぱい詰まったこの学園を、
破壊なんてさせないんだから！！

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Even if the students are facing forward, there's no way the teachers can turn their backs on them!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……生徒が前向いてんのに、
教師が背向けられるかよ！！

text_block_list.name: Student council president.
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I wonder why... Even though I'm trembling like this, I don't feel like running away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
なんでかしらね。
こんなに震えているのに、
逃げる気がしないの。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Alright!! Let's get this over with and keep going! For Kyaru's graduation ceremony!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっしゃあ！！
さっさと片付けて続けようぜ！
キャルの卒業式をよォ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: …It's annoying. There’s no point in you guys trying to help having such low magical power!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うっとうしいわね。
魔力の低いあんたたちがいても
意味ないのよ……！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Students
text_block_list.text: But I won't run away!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: でも逃げない！！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Geez, seriously, what a fool... I thought I'd just buy some time and run away, but now I can't do that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったく、
ホントバカ……
適当に時間だけ稼いで逃げようと思ってたのに、
できなくなったじゃない……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Because of you guys, I have no choice but to defeat this guy!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたちのせいで、
こいつぶっ倒すしかなくなっちゃったじゃない！！

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: ...Her eyes are filled with fearless light. I don't like it. Reminds me of that detestable Ambrose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……恐れを知らぬ光に満ちた目だ。
気に入らん。
忌々しいアンブローズを思い出す。

text_block_list.name: Arges
text_block_list.text: Well, disappear. ...Ooooooh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあよい、
消え失せろ。
……オオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: !! What incredible magical power...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！！　
凄まじい魔力……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You guys, it's really time to run. ...I've received your feelings properly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち、
もういいから本当に逃げて。
……ちゃんと気持ちは受け取ったから。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I will win!!
text_block_list.orig_text: あたしが勝つから！！
